name: Lateral resistance of the ballasted bed

designations.text: Lateral resistance of the ballasted bed

complete_examples.text: In Ref. [6], the modeling method for the vehicle–track dynamic interaction has been illustrated in detail; however, the geometric nonlinearity and large displacement of the rail and the lateral resistance of the ballasted bed are ignored.
In order to avoid the interference of nonlinearity lateral resistance of ballasted bed, the nonlinearity of the lateral resistance of the ballasted bed will not be considered.
